agent.max_rounds_semantics: unlimited; bounded by per-turn and simulation wall clocks

profile.retry_policy: no in-run retries; infrastructure reruns require a new external attempt lineage

seed_application.claim: task/trial identity only; not deterministic replay
seed_application.geode_agent: set_seed is unsupported/no-op on the subscription adapter

user.generation_shape: one upstream LiteLLM generation per user turn
user.total_wall_budget: bounded by the shared simulation timeout

score_authority.domain_metrics: compute_metrics: per-task pass^1..pass^4 across four trials, then arithmetic mean across tasks and percentage conversion
score_authority.headline: arithmetic mean of airline, retail, and telecom pass_1 percentages; not pooled 278-task accuracy
score_authority.infrastructure_errors: excluded by upstream compute_metrics and forbidden by the Lane 1 exit gate
